evidence.text: Compute χ(Y) as the degree of c(TY)∩[Y]. Obtain Chern classes using explicit ambient blowups, Aluffi’s complete-intersection blowup formula and adjunction; push successively through the blowups and then through the ambient projective bundle to B.

evidence.text: Labels sets of Kähler-cone generators by their degeneration types and orders them by inclusion. The associated Hasse diagram records one-generator additions. For non-simplicial cones, retains independent sets and patches simplicial-subcone patterns; rank invariance ensures consistent labels on shared limits.

evidence.text: For even h, differentiate the Hessian determinant polynomial to obtain a symmetric h-array, viewed as a bilinear map on Sym^(h/2)(H). Its determinant is called SymDet; rank and signature remain useful when the determinant vanishes.

evidence.text: Construct a finite covering by maximal polytopes using combined weight systems (CWS), then enumerate IP subpolytopes and all lattices on which they are reflexive. The working covering uses 308 r-minimal CWS, reduced from 201,346 relevant CWS. The embedding x_i=〈V_i,X〉 describes the polar by weight-system linear constraints and x_i≥−1.

evidence.text: Jacobi’s partial-fraction identity expresses complete homogeneous symmetric polynomials as sums over the hypersurface classes of a blowup center. Together with Segre-class identities, linearity and the projection formula, this supplies the exceptional-divisor pushforward theorem.

evidence.text: Uses SAGE for fine regular star triangulations and ambient Kähler cones. Fibration examples use divisor intersection criteria, PALP searches for reflexive subpolytopes, and block structures of CICY configuration matrices.

evidence.text: Which Calabi–Yau threefold compactifications can avoid world-sheet instanton corrections? The section permits finite free quotients of tori and elliptic-curve–K3 products, so its geometric domain extends beyond simply connected threefolds of strict SU(3) holonomy.

sources.title: Mirror symmetry, mirror map and applications to Calabi-Yau hypersurfaces

evidence.text: How can toric geometry construct previously unavailable mirrors and determine mirror maps, Yukawa couplings and instanton invariants for Calabi–Yau hypersurfaces with several moduli?
